purpose: Describe what someone or something is suited to.
keywords: Noun + 向き; noun + 向きの + noun
These shoes are suited to mountain walking.
I do not think I am suited to customer service.
This is a light fabric suitable for summer.
formation: Noun + 向き; noun + 向きの + noun
restrictions: Focuses on suitability, whether or not it was designed for that purpose.
mistake: 向け names the target audience; 向き evaluates the fit.
